quotations.old_english: On ðære ǽ ðú hý drencst
quotations.english: thou shalt give them to drink of the stream

quotations.old_english: Ðæt hí ne meahtan acwellan cnyhta ǽ
quotations.english: that they might not destroy the young men's lives

source_text: ǽ. Add :-- Æ-acute;s þínre legis tuae, Ps. Rdr. 58, 12: 9, 21. v. heáfod- (?), synder-ǽ.
ǽ; indecl. f. A river, stream; rivus, torrens :-- On ðære ǽ ðú hý drencst thou shalt give them to drink of the stream; torrente potabis eos, Ps. Th. 35, 8. v. eá.
ǽ; indecl. f. Life; vita :-- Ðæt hí ne meahtan acwellan cnyhta ǽ that they might not destroy the young men's lives, Exon. 55a; Th. 195, 32; Az. 164.
